labs.pi_title: Faculty Director, IPC; co-leads the Work of the Future Initiative
labs.research_summary: Researches manufacturing, progress studies and the future of work, drawing on faculty, student and staff affiliates across MIT.
labs.member_breakdown: 1 Faculty Director, 1 Research Scientist based at the IPC itself (Florian Metzler, leads the Progress Studies program) -- excludes faculty affiliates, fellows and students whose primary appointment/lab is elsewhere at MIT
labs.notes: IPC is a cross-cutting center; most listed 'Our Team' members (David Autor, Suzanne Berger, John Hart, Jason Jackson, Kate Kellogg, Retsef Levi, David Mindell, Paul Osterman, Michael Piore, Sanjay Sarma, etc.) are MIT faculty affiliates whose primary labs are recorded in their home departments -- not duplicated here. Founding Executive Director/Faculty Chair Richard Lester (NSE) also noted but not counted as a current IPC-based PI.
